jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Customer Care Project & SRS Coordinator who will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of customer projects from quotation through delivery. Acting as the link between multiple internal stakeholders, this person will help drive operational excellence while ensuring an outstanding customer experience.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

 
Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturer with a long-standing history of innovation and excellence. Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.
 

Omschrijving

 

• Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.
• Act as a key point of contact between internal departments to ensure seamless project execution.
• Manage quotation and order-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Monitor material availability and proactively expedite orders when required.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain teams to guarantee timely delivery of products.
• Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
• Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
• Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.
• Contribute to operational projects and provide support to management when needed.
 

 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in customer service, project coordination or operations.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
• Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.

The successful candidate will maintain positive relationships with clients, legal professionals, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the highest level of confidentiality at all times.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

 

Description

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. • Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• You are proactive, persuasive, structured, and a true team player 

• Able to multitask and work under pressure in a small but ambitious team

As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.

You'll spend approximately

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.

Your role and responsibilities;

• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards.
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products.
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment.
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity.

This role is suited for you if you:

• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
• Communicate fluently in English.
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:
This newly created position combines technical accounting expertise, business partnering and people management, offering the opportunity to build and develop a function with significant visibility across the organization.You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.

jobs.description:

• Support construction and real estate projects, including related contractual negotiations.
• Monitor and advise on consumer law matters impacting the Belgian business.

• Identify legal risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.
• Strengthen compliance frameworks and internal governance procedures.
• Collaborate closely with departments such as Procurement, Marketing, Communications, and Operations.

• Master's degree in Law obtained from a Belgian university.

• Fluent in English, ideally in Dutch as well (or conversational level)
• Strong expertise in: Commercial contracts, Consumer law, Real estate and construction law
• Exposure to ESG-related matters is considered a strong asset.
• Comfortable working independently and managing a broad legal scope.

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.

• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.

• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
